d: We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Junior / Middle Project Manager to lead and coordinate our cross-functional marketing and real estate projects; for work in the UAE (Dubai), but for the Georgian market.

‼️ The most important requirements for this role are fluency in Georgian, preferably 1.5 years of experience in coordination, team, project or product management and either being currently based in Dubai or having worked in Dubai within the past few years.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing cross-functional initiatives and ensuring smooth communication between internal teams (architects, engineers, designers, and sales managers). The key responsibility is to monitor and maintain project-related assets, including websites and marketing materials.
This is full-time office-based role with working schedule: Monday-Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Office located in Dubai Hills or Al Barsha (Art of Living Mall).
q: Preferably 1.5+ years of experience in Coordination, Team, Project or Product Management;
Fluent English and Georgian (both written and spoken);
Experience managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously;
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequently changing priorities;
Experience with project management tools (Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or similar) is an advantage;
Previous experience coordinating cross-functional projects is a plus.
r: Manage and coordinate our marketing and real estate projects for the Georgian market;
Own project timelines, priorities, and execution across multiple teams;
Coordinate with Architecture, Sales, Marketing, Design, and other internal stakeholders;
Monitor and maintain project-related assets, including websites, marketing materials, and printed collateral;
Ensure all deliverables are completed on time and meet quality standards;
Track project progress, identify risks, and proactively resolve issues;
Adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs while keeping projects on track.
x: Opportunity to work on international real estate projects;
Professional growth and career development opportunities.

d: Engineering Manager will be deputed to site and be responsible for leading and coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities during the engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and project close-out phases of the power project. This role will act as the principal engineering interface between the Client/Owner, Owner’s Engineer team, EPC Contractor, OEMs, vendors and other project stakeholders, ensuring that the EPC Contractor’s design and engineering deliverables meet the project requirements, contractual obligations, applicable codes and standards, safety requirements and agreed schedule. Engineering Manager will provide technical leadership to the engineering team, manage interdisciplinary interfaces and ensure that engineering issues are identified, addressed and closed without adversely affecting procurement, construction or commissioning.
q: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related field.
Minimum of 15 years of mechanical engineering experience, with a focus on power generation projects.
Experience with Closed/Open Cycle Gas Turbine Projects and Sub station Projects
Profound knowledge of mechanical systems, codes, and standards.
Demonstrated expertise in project management and team leadership.
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?
r: Lead and coordinate the multidisciplinary engineering team, including mechanical, electrical, I&C, civil/structural and other specialist disciplines.
Establish priorities for engineering reviews in line with the overall EPC and construction programme.
Coordinate engineering activities from detailed design through construction, testing, commissioning and handover.
Ensure that engineering deliverables are reviewed within the contractual review periods. Monitor engineering progress and identify potential schedule or technical risks at an early stage.
Conduct regular engineering coordination and interdisciplinary interface meetings. Provide technical direction and guidance to discipline leads and site engineering personnel.

Manage the Owner’s Engineer review of EPC Contractor engineering submissions, including: Design criteria and design basis documents PFDs and P&IDs Heat and mass balances Equipment specifications and datasheets System calculations Electrical single-line diagrams Control philosophies and logic Civil and structural drawings General arrangement drawings Vendor documentation Interface documentation Testing and commissioning procedures
Ensure EPC designs comply with project specifications, contractual requirements, applicable international standards and good engineering practice.
Maintain consistency between engineering disciplines and identify/interface clashes before they impact construction.
Act as the primary engineering coordination interface between the Client, EPC Contractor, Owner’s Engineer disciplines, OEMs and vendors.
Manage interdisciplinary interfaces between major plant systems and packages.
Coordinate resolution of Technical Queries, Requests for Information, engineering deviations and design changes.
Ensure technical issues affecting multiple disciplines are appropriately evaluated and resolved.
Support resolution of interfaces with utilities and external stakeholders where required. Construction & Site Engineering Support
Provide engineering support to the site construction team.
Resolve design-related issues arising during construction.
Coordinate responses to site technical queries and drawing discrepancies.
Review EPC design changes proposed during construction and assess their technical and contractual implications.
Verify that construction follows approved design documentation and specifications.
Coordinate engineering solutions where site conditions require modification of the approved design.
Support resolution and closure of engineering-related NCRs. Equipment & Vendor Engineering
Coordinate technical review of major equipment packages.
Review and monitor vendor engineering documentation and interfaces.
Ensure vendor requirements are correctly incorporated into the overall plant design.
Support technical evaluation and resolution of vendor deviations.
Coordinate engineering input for factory inspections and FATs where applicable.
Support resolution of vendor technical issues during erection, testing and commissioning. Engineering Schedule & Deliverables
Monitor the EPC Contractor’s engineering programme and document submission schedule.
Identify engineering activities on or approaching the project critical path.
Coordinate priorities for Owner’s Engineer review to avoid delays to procurement and construction.
Monitor overdue engineering submissions and technical actions.
Participate in engineering progress and EPC coordination meetings.
Provide regular engineering progress, risk and issue reporting to the Project Manager. Change & Risk Management
Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
Assess proposed design changes, deviations and concessions.
Evaluate potential schedule, constructability, operability and performance impacts of engineering changes.
Provide technical inputs to contractual/commercial change assessments where required.
Ensure engineering decisions and agreed deviations are adequately documented. Quality, HSE & Compliance
Ensure design and engineering activities incorporate applicable HSE requirements, including safe access, maintainability, operability and constructability.
Support design risk assessments, HAZOP and other technical safety studies as applicable.
Ensure engineering activities comply with the Project Quality Plan and established document-control procedures.
Promote incorporation of lessons learned and good engineering practices. Testing, Commissioning & Handover
Provide engineering support during system completion, testing and commissioning.
Coordinate resolution of engineering issues identified during commissioning.
Support review of commissioning procedures and performance-test documentation.
Monitor incorporation of engineering modifications into final documentation.
Support review and acceptance of as-built drawings, O&M manuals and final project documentation.
Assist with technical close-out and handover to the Client/Operator.
